hypothesis: Pilot-allocated frozen-direction ratio evaluation costs at least 20% less than complete-bank reconstruction at common estimation accuracy and unconditional success probability on every declared input.
evidence: ideal IID joint Pauli-shot simulation; illustrative serial device timing; no hardware or quantum advantage claim
hamiltonian: open TFIM: -J sum Z_q Z_(q+1) - h sum X_q; q0 leftmost
span_policy: all three predeclared generators; pilot overlap truncation learns retained frame and c; evaluation never refits c
seed_rule: master_seed + 100000*case_index + 1000*budget_index + 3*replica + stream; streams 0 pilot, 1 ratio, 2 bank
pilot_allocation: uniform with integer remainders in setting order
ratio_allocation: Neyman sqrt(pilot group variance of f_H-E_pilot*f_S), minimum 2 per fresh evaluation setting, largest-remainder integer rounding
bank_allocation: Neyman sqrt(sum pilot group variances over independent real S/H entry functionals), minimum 2 per fresh evaluation setting, largest-remainder integer rounding
baseline: reconstruct all S/H entries from fresh complete-bank shots; evaluate the same frozen pilot c; no held-out refit; optional re-solve is not a decision input
ratio_interval: Bonferroni joint Hoeffding rectangle for f_H,f_S, transformed by four ratio corners only when denominator lower bound exceeds floor; covariance retained in point/delta diagnostic; no independence assumption between H and S
success_probability_rule: one-sided exact binomial lower bounds, Bonferroni across all 18 input/budget/arm cells
failure_rule: pilot solve failures, denominator failures, nonfinite outputs, owned-array admission failures and monitored RSS breaches are failures in all 128 replica denominators; charge all work actually spent
memory_scope: conservative retained-array and dense-workspace admission model, not Python heap or RSS; RSS is independently monitored as process high-water mark
end_to_end_cost: serial device preparation/readout/gate-time surrogate + measured provider compilation, pilot reconstruction/solve/freezing/allocation and evaluation reconstruction/inference seconds; ideal simulator drawing time separately reported; exact assessment excluded and separately timed
promotion_rule: for each arm/input take cheapest declared budget whose simultaneous binomial lower success bound is at least 0.9; ratio median end-to-end cost <= 0.8*bank at every input, with no memory failure; otherwise close this frozen hypothesis without tuning or adding variants
assessment_only: independent dense tensor-Pauli S/H, exact retained-frame energy, true pilot-direction quotient, and full-space ground energy; never supplied to consumer or allocation
report_errors: estimation error around true frozen pilot-direction quotient
